headline: Highest risk is Authelia’s broad network/OIDC surface interacting with an unverified AI-engineering-hub pair; prompt-injection and leakage are otherwise limited by missing shared I/O.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ai-engineering-hub is docs-only and not runnable, so direct injection is not evidenced. However, it references MCP/RAG tags while Authelia exposes OIDC/ForwardAuth APIs and broad egress, so a manual or API-mediated content bridge is plausible. The pairwise pathway is inferred, not documented, so uncertainty keeps this low rather than none.
conditions: IF an operator copies ai-engineering-hub output into an Authelia-managed workflow
IF Authelia is configured to ingest external text via ForwardAuth or OIDC claims processing
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Disable any manual copy-paste bridge between outputs and auth rules
Require human review before using generated text in policy or claim mappings
Log and diff any imported configuration text
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between producer and consumer

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows touched sensitive data or shared storage, and ai-engineering-hub has no filesystem surface. Authelia does handle authentication APIs and broad egress, but without a shared workspace or secrets-handling evidence, leakage is only a weak, indirect possibility. The pair does not currently show a default data path that would expose user data.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace or config directory
IF Authelia is fed files containing secrets or identity data
mitigations: Store each agent’s files in separate directories
Avoid placing secrets in any shared input folder
Review Authelia logs for accidental payload capture
Restrict outbound destinations for Authelia where possible
requires-engineering: enforce workspace isolation at the orchestrator

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ai-engineering-hub is not runnable and has no write or network permissions listed, while Authelia has broad egress but no subprocess or filesystem write capability shown. With no overlapping mutable resource or shared lock domain, a write conflict pathway is not supported by the profiles. The interaction is therefore provably absent from the documented surfaces.
conditions: IF a future deployment grants both agents write access to the same directory
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state or locking-free git operations
mitigations: Keep ai-engineering-hub non-runnable
Do not grant shared filesystem write access
Avoid colocating both agents in the same git working tree
Document any future shared mutable resource
requires-engineering: add explicit locking if shared writes are introduced

D_cascading_error.rationale: ai-engineering-hub’s MCP/RAG-oriented content could be treated as guidance, and Authelia’s OIDC/ForwardAuth role means it may operationalize configuration or access decisions. That creates a plausible chain where A’s output influences B without a verification step. The pairwise pathway is inferred from documented surfaces, not directly observed, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF Authelia consumes text or rules derived from ai-engineering-hub without human verification
IF generated guidance is converted into authentication or forwarding policy
mitigations: Require a second reviewer for any imported guidance
Test policy changes in a staging Authelia instance
Keep generated content out of production auth rules
Add a checklist item for source verification
requires-engineering: implement validation gates before policy deployment

E_compliance.rationale: No PHI, residency, or retention-sensitive data classes are listed for either agent, so there is no documented compliance breach today. Authelia’s authentication role could become compliance-relevant if it processes regulated identity data, but ai-engineering-hub shows no such data handling. The only cited agent needing mention is Authelia because the compliance surface is one-sided here.
conditions: IF regulated identity data is routed through Authelia
IF retention or residency policies are imposed on data not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Confirm whether regulated data is in scope before deployment
Review Authelia retention settings
Avoid sending regulated data to ai-engineering-hub
Document data-class boundaries
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls to the pipeline
